text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Robert Hedley has resigned from the Property Standards Committee effective January 5, 2021. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are working on a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration in the coming months. The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel will also have to appoint a Chair, term of office until October 24, 2022, or until a successor is appointed.
The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Received the item for information.
